description.value: This study investigated regional brain atrophy and white matter microstructural alterations in frontotemporal lobar degeneration subtypes using structural MRI and diffusion tensor imaging, and compared their classification ability.

spans.text: This study was to investigate to what extent the pattern of white matter microstructural alterations in FTLD subtypes mirrors the pattern of brain atrophy

value: Compared to CN, bvFTD patients showed FA reductions bilaterally in the frontal and temporal white matter. value: Compared to CN, SD patients showed FA reductions in bilateral uncinate fasciculi and in the left temporal white matter regions. The regional patterns of increased DR were similar to the pattern of FA reduction but in a larger region of the left temporal white matter, while increased DA was largely overlapped with increased DR.

Comparison between PNFA and CN

definition.value: Compared to CN, PNFA patients showed a moderate FA reduction predominantly in the left arcuate fasciculus region, with increased DR and DA.

spans.text: Comparisons between each FTLD subtype and control group were tested voxel-by-voxel using two-sample t-tests with diagnosis as the main effect.

value: Compared to CN, PNFA patients showed a moderate FA reduction predominantly in the left arcuate fasciculus region, most pronounced in the fronto-parietal component. Increased DR was also observed predominantly in the dorsal part of the left arcuate fasciculus region, while increased DA was mostly seen in the left superior motor pathway and some extra-fiber areas adjacent to the left arcuate fasciculus.
